intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

caseStudy.title: CGIAR
caseStudy.lead: A responsive, component-driven frontend for CGIAR, the global agricultural research partnership: reusable components that the client's editors assemble into pages in Drupal.

brief.title: The brief
text: CGIAR publishes research, news and programmes from many centres around the world. Its editors needed a library of components they can combine into pages themselves, without a developer for every new page.
Every component had to be responsive, accessible and robust with real content, and fit cleanly into Drupal.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built reusable, responsive components in Twig, SCSS and TypeScript.
Showed every component and its variants in Nitro previews for design and QA review.
Integrated the components into Drupal-managed pages together with the backend developers.
Worked with designers, Drupal developers, the project manager and QA through review and testing.

team.title: Team
team.text: Frontend and Drupal developers, designers, a project manager and QA, working together on one component library.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A component library the client's editors use to build and change pages on their own, on every screen size.
